inputs.raw_text: We're hiking Tour du Mont Blanc. I want an emotional cinematic film that shows the scale of the mountains and the feeling of the journey, with a slow gradual build. Keep it about us but mostly the landscape.

expected_properties: subject references the hike / Tour du Mont Blanc
pace reflects slow or gradual build if captured
preserves the 'mostly landscape, some us' balance as a constraint or emphasis
forbidden_properties: invents specific scene objects (a specific ridge, specific weather)
